title: Polaroid PZ1710 35mm Point & Shoot Film Camera ( Battery Cover Comes Off )
descriptionText:
The battery cover is taped on because it comes off. Works fine.

Capture timeless moments with the Polaroid PZ1710 35mm Point & Shoot Film Camera. This classic piece of photography equipment comes from the renowned Polaroid brand and features a sleek silver design. With a fixed focus lens, you can easily snap sharp photos without the hassle of manual focusing. 

The camera is lightweight and easy to carry around, weighing only 7.04 Oz. It also includes a built-in flash for those low-light situations. Perfect for film photography enthusiasts and professionals alike, this camera is a great addition to any collection.
